national_news.title: 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting Held in New Delhi
bullets: Union Minister Bhupender Yadav addressed the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi, emphasizing people-centric environmental action.
India's BRICS chairship is guided by the vision of 'Building Resilience and Innovation for Cooperation and Sustainability' (BRICS), focusing on the Global South.
The meeting concluded with the adoption of a Joint Ministerial Statement reaffirming commitments to the UNFCCC, Paris Agreement, and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

national_news.title: MEA Highlights Credibility of India's Election Machinery and Foreign Policy Updates
bullets: MEA Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that the credibility and robustness of India's election machinery are well-established globally.
India expressed deep condolences and offered assistance to Indonesia following a massive earthquake.
India reiterated its firm stance against cross-border terrorism and highlighted ongoing energy and development cooperation discussions with Bangladesh.

national_news.title: Supreme Court to Form High-Powered Committee on Delhi Student Protests
bullets: The Supreme Court announced plans to constitute a high-powered committee comprising retired judges, an ex-DGP, and a former CBI director.
The panel will conduct fact-finding regarding allegations of police excesses against student protesters and violence against police personnel in Delhi.
The committee will also examine allegations of sexual assault, online harassment, and review video footage and CCTV recordings of the July 20 Parliament march.

national_news.title: Government Approves Incentive Scheme to Promote Domestic PNG Connections
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and National Gas approved an Incentive Scheme for Promotion of Domestic PNG Connections, effective from the 1st of next month.
City Gas Distribution (CGD) entities will be allocated an additional 200 Standard Cubic Meters of lower-priced domestic gas for every incremental billed Domestic PNG connection.
The scheme aims to fast-track the expansion of the current 1.74 crore domestic Piped Natural Gas connections and lower gas-sourcing costs.

national_news.title: Indian Shuttlers Advance at BWF Badminton World Championships
bullets: Lakshya Sen advanced to the men's singles second round at the BWF Badminton World Championships after defeating Austria's Collins Filimon.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand advanced to the pre-quarterfinals by defeating Lauren Lam and Allison Lee.
Unnati Hooda also advanced to the women's singles second round by overcoming Myanmar's Thet Htar Thuzar.

national_news.title: Jharkhand Government Cancels 44 Recruitment Exams Over Irregularities
bullets: The Jharkhand government cancelled 44 recruitment exams conducted by JPSC and outsourced agencies since 2014 due to alleged irregularities.
Cancelled exams include recruitment for civil judges, assistant professors, drug inspectors, and the JSSC-Combined Graduate Level examination.
The state announced plans to request a fast-track court for irregularities cases and established an internal vigilance cell and reform committee led by IAS officer Amitabh Kaushal.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announces month-long youth banking campaign starting October 2, 2026
bullets: The two-day PSB Confluence 2026 was organised by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, concluding with a focus on growth strategies for public sector banks.

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a focused, month-long banking outreach campaign starting October 2, 2026, targeted at youth above 16 years of age through the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
The initiative will feature a common online portal for single-window access to banking, skilling, and entrepreneurship opportunities, alongside physical outreach across educational institutions.

national_news.title: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan chairs 97th ICAR Annual General Meeting
bullets: The 97th Annual General Meeting of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) Society was held at the National Agricultural Science Complex (NASC), New Delhi.
Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan emphasized integrated farming systems and demand-driven research to diversify incomes of small and marginal farmers.
The ministers highlighted the vision of achieving self-reliance in agriculture, pulses, oilseeds, and strengthening FPOs to realize Viksit Bharat by 2047.

national_news.title: Ministry of Agriculture adopts 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' roadmap for rural development
bullets: A commitment programme was organized in New Delhi for departments under the Ministries of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Rural Development to implement 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara'.
The framework translates Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Independence Day roadmap into action for agriculture, food processing, and rural empowerment.
The event saw a collective pledge by officials, scientists, Lakhpati Didis, and FPO representatives to align efforts with building a self-reliant and prosperous India.

national_news.title: India's FTA export landscape expands with record merchandise and services exports
bullets: Combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports alone touching US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026, combined exports grew by 11.37% year-on-year to reach US$ 232.73 billion.
The India-UAE CEPA (effective May 1, 2022) emerged as India's largest individual FTA export market, crossing US$ 100 billion in bilateral trade within three years.

national_news.title: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports Announces National Sports Awards 2025
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports announced the National Sports Awards 2025, recommended by a Selection Committee chaired by former Supreme Court Judge Justice (Retd.) Arun Kumar Mishra.

Prestigious Arjuna Awards 2025 were conferred upon prominent sportspersons including Tejaswin Shankar (Athletics), Treesa Jolly and Pullela Gayatri Gopichand (Badminton), Vidit Santosh Gujarathi and Divya Jitendra Deshmukh (Chess), among others.

The Dronacharya Award in the regular category was awarded to coaches Parveer Singh (Athletics), Chhote Lal Yadav (Boxing), and Neha Nandkumar Chavan (Shooting), while the Army Paralympic Node, Pune received the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar 2025.

national_news.title: Indian Army Contingent Departs for India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV
bullets: The 15th edition of the India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV (2026) is being conducted from 18 to 31 August 2026 at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp, Surat Thani, Thailand.
Both Indian Army and Royal Thai Army contingents comprise 85 personnel each, with the Indian side represented primarily by troops from the 9 Gorkha Rifles.
Instituted in 2006, the exercise focuses on company-level joint training for Counter Insurgency and Terrorist Operations in jungle and semi-urban environments under Chapter VII of the UN Charter.

bihar_news.title: India's Carbon Credit Programmes and Smallholder Farmer Participation
bullets: Focuses on the Indian Carbon Market and the Green Credit Programme implemented by the Government of India.
Highlights that smallholder farmers constitute over 80 percent of India's farming population but face participation barriers in voluntary carbon markets.
A study involving smallholder farmers in Bihar indicates that upfront financial support, technical assistance, and machinery access are critical for effective programme design.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Joins Centre's Direct Pulse Procurement Network
bullets: In a first, Bihar has joined the Centre's direct pulse procurement network, bypassing the state's abolished APMC system (2006).
Central agencies like NCCF and Nafed have procured masoor directly from farmers, depositing payments at the MSP of ₹7,000 per quintal.
Bihar produces nearly 400,000 tonnes of pulses annually across approximately 448,000 hectares of cultivated land.

bihar_news.title: Darbhanga Ranks Second in Bihar for Sugarcane IDs
bullets: Darbhanga has emerged as Bihar’s second-highest district with 24,215 farmers obtaining Sugarcane IDs under the sugarcane expansion campaign.
West Champaran holds the top rank in Bihar for the number of Sugarcane IDs issued.
The Sugarcane ID initiative connects farmers with government schemes, technical support, and cultivation-related incentives.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Resume Mining Operations from October 15, Announces CM Samrat Choudhary
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the auction of critical and strategic mineral blocks and the NMEDT workshop organized by the Ministry of Coal and Mines in Patna.
The state government announced that over 30 out of 44 surveyed coal and mineral blocks will be allocated before September 30, with mining operations officially slated to begin on October 15.
Key mineral-rich regions identified for optimal resource utilization include Rohtas (limestone), Aurangabad, Jehanabad, Jamui, Gaya, Banka, and Bhagalpur.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Hosts Auction Workshop for Critical and Strategic Mineral Blocks
bullets: CM Samrat Choudhary addressed the roadshow and NMEDT workshop in Patna focusing on the auction of critical and strategic mineral blocks.
The event aimed to boost investments, strategic partnerships, and explore industrial opportunities within Bihar's mining sector.
Union Minister of State for Coal and Mines Satish Chandra Dubey and senior ministry officials participated in the event.

bihar_news.title: Tender Process Underway for 28 Mining Blocks in Bihar: CM
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced that tender processes for 28 mining blocks are currently active.
More than 30 critical and strategic mineral blocks are targeted for allocation before the end of September.
Mining activities across these allocated blocks are scheduled to resume post-October 15 to ramp up state revenue and industrial growth.
